name: Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium
about: Home of Sunrisers Hyderabad and a premier IPL venue. The stadium features three main stands, a VIP pavilion, dual concourses, and integrated command-and-control systems for high-attendance limited-overs cricket.

history.event: Stadium inaugurated; first international fixture hosted.
Major floodlight and seating upgrades for IPL expansion.
Concourse B food court expansion — added CCTV mesh coverage.
Digital twin blueprint integrated into CrowdSphere command platform.
Post-match egress AI routing pilot deployed across all nine gates.

securityRecords.summary: Post-innings break surge at Gate 4 — queue exceeded 180 for 6 minutes.
securityRecords.prevention: Deploy throttle at G4 when concourse density >75%; pre-stage stewards at South B choke point.

securityRecords.summary: Bag left near Concourse B — cleared in 4 min after CCTV flag.
securityRecords.prevention: Maintain Gemini vision sweep every 5 min on Concourse B feeds during peak F&B.

securityRecords.summary: Minor altercation in North Stand queue — de-escalated, no injuries.
securityRecords.prevention: Increase visible security at G1/G2 when North Stand >80% capacity pre-match.

securityRecords.summary: Lightning within 4 mi — delayed ingress to East Terrace 22 minutes.
securityRecords.prevention: Auto shelter protocol webhook now triggers at 3 mi (implemented Jan 2026).

securityRecords.summary: Record attendance egress crush risk at North B — hold applied 12 min.
securityRecords.prevention: Post-match egress playbook: open G5 diversion + free water incentive (proven May 2026 pilot).

preventionPlaybook: Correlate gate queue length with zone density — hold ingress before queues exceed 150.
Repeat-incident gates (G1, G4, G8) get extra stewards 45 min before peak phases.
Apply lessons from international matches to IPL sell-outs (earlier egress messaging).
Use vision AI on Concourse B after any unattended-item flag within 30 days.
Lightning <3 mi: auto shelter protocol — no manual approval required.
